name: Mattermost
tagline: Self-hosted team chat modelled on Slack
description: Channel-based team chat with threads, reactions, slash commands and integrations, laid out almost exactly like Slack. A single Go server with PostgreSQL behind it, plus desktop and mobile apps.
licenseNote: Team Edition builds are MIT-licensed (the source is AGPL-3.0 and Apache-2.0). Since version 11, Team Edition is capped at 250 users and no longer includes GitLab SSO, and the default free install is a separate 'Entry' edition that shows only the most recent 10,000 messages. Install Team Edition explicitly if you want unlimited history.
backing: Mattermost, Inc. (US, venture-backed), funded by Professional and Enterprise licences

maturity.rationale: Mature, stable and widely deployed, including in defence and government. Marked down for a pattern of moving features out of the free edition, most recently in versions 10 and 11.

selfHosting.summary: A Go binary and PostgreSQL; the official Docker setup is straightforward. Push notifications for the mobile apps go through Mattermost's hosted relay unless you build and run your own.

requirements.notes: Comfortable for a few hundred users. File uploads need disk or S3-compatible storage.

managedHosting.label: Mattermost Cloud
managedHosting.note: Hosted by Mattermost on paid per-user plans

strengths: Feels like Slack on day one: same layout, channels, threads, reactions and slash commands
Official tooling imports Slack channels, users, threads and message history
Slack-compatible webhooks mean many existing integrations work with a changed URL
weaknesses: Open core, and the line keeps moving: single sign-on (GitLab sign-in included, since version 11), guest accounts and compliance features are paid
Calls in the free edition are limited to one-to-one, with a time cap; group calls need a licence
The default free install since version 11 is the Entry edition, which limits message history; Team Edition has to be chosen explicitly

featureNotes.calls: One-to-one only in Team Edition; group calls are paid
featureNotes.free-sso: SAML and OpenID Connect are paid features
featureNotes.unlimited-history: In Team Edition; the Entry edition shows only the latest 10,000 messages
